status: OBSERVED AND MEASURED, NOT ADJUDICATED. The orchestrator does not decide these; the peer, the boss and the author wave do. This exists so none of them has to rediscover the pattern one cluster at a time.
the_pattern: a parashah mark recorded ON a verse marks the division AFTER that verse. Several rows instead credit such a mark as corroborating that same verse as their own ONSET, which puts the mark's evidential direction backwards and makes it interior to the span rather than front-seam evidence. In at least one cluster the SAME mark is read one way by one row and the opposite way by the adjacent row.
why_it_is_a_pattern_and_not_five_defects: it is one convention applied inconsistently, in three separate clusters and two separate parts, found independently by both lanes wherever both lanes have run. A per-row repair would fix five sentences and leave the convention unstated; a single ruling on which direction a recorded mark carries, applied book-wide, fixes the class.
independently_converged: c04 P02-008 and c06 P03-006 were each found by BOTH lanes, blind to one another. That is the dual-blind design reporting a real signal rather than a lens artefact.
what_no_instance_claims: not one of these findings moves a span. Every reviewer kept the boundary and challenged the stated ground, and two lowered a confidence level. The spans are holding; the reasons given for them are not.
not_yet_swept: clusters c08-c22 are not launched and c01-c03 were reviewed before this pattern was visible. Whether the same inversion stands in the other 19 clusters is UNKNOWN and must be swept, not assumed - the sweep is a mechanical check of every row that cites a mark as onset evidence against the mark's recorded verse.

second_pattern_converged_on_the_defect_a.the_shared_finding: the row declines an interior seam on the express ground that MT 14:21 introduces no messenger onset. MT 14:21 opens on the messenger formula and is a counted member of the 122-verse census. Both lanes established this independently and both rated it HIGH.

LF_lane.reasoning: the formula at 14:21 is subordinated by its opening conjunction and the address does not change, so the span holds and only the stated ground needs correcting

OL_lane.reasoning: a petuchah stands after MT 14:20, whose oath carries the utterance signature, and the address turns to 2mp at MT 14:22-23, so both branches of the ruled sub-onset test hold and the seam should be cut

second_pattern_converged_on_the_defect_a.why_this_is_the_most_valuable_result_in_: the dual-blind pair did not merely agree. It agreed on the FACT, disagreed on the CONSEQUENCE, and each side argued its case from the bytes. That is a genuine adjudication delivered to the boss with both briefs already written, which is what two independent lenses are for; a single reviewer would have produced one answer and no sign that the other was arguable.
second_pattern_converged_on_the_defect_a.what_the_orchestrator_does_with_it: NOTHING. It is recorded verbatim on both sides and routed upward undecided.
second_pattern_converged_on_the_defect_a.one_open_question_the_OL_lane_named_agai: whether a three-verse row opened by a messenger formula rather than a word-event satisfies the over-split floor, whose named three-verse precedent is a complete word-event unit - the main structural cost of its own cut, disclosed by the lane proposing it

for_the_author_wave: if the convention is ruled as the reviewers read it, the repair is a disclosure change in each affected row and in no case a span change. Two reviewers said this explicitly and unprompted.
limit: an orchestrator's index of what the reviewers found; it decides nothing and authorizes nothing
